title: Mt._Silver
lead_summary:
Mt. Silver is a huge mountain in Kanto, and is considered end-game content. It can be accessed from Mt. Silver Base and will lead to Mt. Silver Summit.
The player's Rival will give Rock Climb, which will be required to climb the entire mountain, however to reach him the player will also require Surf and Waterfall.
Cynthia will not allow the player to go to the Summit, in fear of the beast's strength, unless she is defeated in battle.
